name: SWI/SNF related BAF chromatin remodeling complex subunit E1
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: SMARCE1 encodes SWI/SNF-related matrix-associated actin-dependent regulator of chromatin subfamily E member 1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and N-acetyltransferase activity. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Coffin-Siris syndrome (autosomal dominant); familial meningioma (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.
